tex_content.html:
Lemma
[proper $\Rightarrow $ complete]

1. ch7:2.8

A metric space in which closed bounded sets are compact is complete.
Proof

\sketch A Cauchy sequence is bounded, so its closure is compact and it has a convergent subsequence. The Cauchy property then forces the whole sequence to converge.

□
